published_title: Villianous ISB - undefeated at Ohio States
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Armus''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.
description: Andy McClure is the MAN His old skool ISB scum deck gave me an idea... It won by 21, 23, and 27... so I guess updating a good deck was a good idea :o)
cards: posted: Sunsdown & Too Cold for Speeders
Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
posted: Ghhk & Those Rebels wont Escape Us
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (6)': ISB/Total Sinisterness (ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents), Coruscant, Prepared Defenses, No Bargain, TinT/OE (There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement) and '[Resistance or Secret Plans]'; these count toward the 60. No single starting Effect is fixed, so starting.effect is left empty. Total 60 as published.

Played at the 2001 Ohio State Championship: this Dark deck won all three games (by 21, 23 and 27); the poster signs as 'Ohio 7th place'. The post says the deck updates Andy McClure's ISB scum deck. A 'Deck Edit' says he wishes he had pulled 1 Twi'lek Advisor for First Strike for states, so the posted list is the one played.

5/20 update (after states, not applied to the list): pull Projective Telepathy, Evader & Monnok, Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us and an Outer Rim Scout for Masterful Move, Monnok, Ghhhk and Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down; that version went 3-0 at a Columbus local, beating Matt Scott (Ohio 5th place, QMC/Avatar) by 29. The strategy calls Control & Set For Stun his '61st card'.

'[Resistance or Secret Plans]' is posted twice (once in Starting, once in Effects): the deck holds one Resistance and one Secret Plans and starts either, depending on the matchup. Kept as two rows as written.

Posted 'ISB/Total Sinisterness' dested ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents; 'Puny-arse Jabba' dested the Special Edition Jabba (power 2, the weakest Jabba of the time, a joke on Mighty Jabba); 'Boba in Bubble' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Zuckass in Party Wagon' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Bossk in Bus' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth.
Posted 'Fett w/Gun', 'IG88 w/Gun', 'Dengar w/Gun' and '4-Lom w/Gun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, IG-88 With Riot Gun, Dengar With Blaster Carbine and 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle.
Posted Coruscant and 'JP Audience Chamber' dested the Dark printings (Coruscant: the Special Edition Dark system).
'Tat Jabba's Palace' is posted x3 (a unique site); kept as published.
